headline.purpose: The wordmark (line-height 1), Explore group heads and "Add an address"; 21.6sp natively for the action-bar wordmark, start-screen title and error head.

title-small.purpose: Result titles and Explore site names (at 1.4), under the highlighter while unread.

body.purpose: Paragraphs only: snippets (70ch, three lines), router explanations, the crawl detail, empty-state and Add copy; the platform sans natively.

label.purpose: Capitals for controls: chips, buttons, text buttons, router names in the trust panel, the files disclosure.

meta.purpose: The summary, meta lines and counts, with tabular figures; submit results.

address.purpose: Every address, one line, ellipsised and shortened at both ends.

state.purpose: The trust strip's router names and the crawler's word, in capitals.

shadows.name: focus-line
shadows.purpose: With the field's 2px bottom rule turned glow, thickens a focused text line to 4px. Draws a line; never light.

shadows.name: hollow-square

shadows.name: ground-frame

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every web transition and keyframe entrance (--ease).

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Border, background and colour changes on chips, buttons, the trust strip and field lines; the ink block arriving on hover.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: The trust panel opening (fade and 6px drop), chevrons turning 180 degrees, the focus line thickening.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: A result new to the list fades in from 0.4 opacity and rises 4px; rows already showing stay still.

motion.name: search-debounce
motion.purpose: Typing pause before a search runs.

motion.name: skeleton-delay
motion.purpose: Skeleton rows appear only when a search takes longer than this; there is no spinner.

motion.name: skeleton-blink
motion.purpose: Skeleton bars blink to 0.45 opacity in two steps, like a copier's lamp, not a smooth shimmer.

motion.name: connecting-breathe
motion.purpose: A connecting router's square dims to 0.35 opacity and back.

motion.name: copied-confirm
motion.purpose: How long the copy button shows its green check.

motion.name: browser-open-enter
motion.purpose: Android: the browser scales from 0.94 (pivot 50% / 60%) and fades in over the search page.

motion.name: browser-open-exit
motion.purpose: Android: the search page fades to 0.6 behind the opening browser.

motion.name: reduced-motion

narrative.overview:
OMNId looks like a zine someone photocopied about the networks they explore. It has one monospace face, ruled lines, square marks, and a highlighter run through the titles worth reading. It is meant to look made, not themed. It rejects two looks: the soft rounded app the first build shipped (pills, tonal cards, rounded fields) and the black-and-neon "dark web" costume. It keeps the icon's navy palette in both schemes, so it is still recognisably the same product.

Structure is drawn with lines. A ruled strip carries the routers' state, the search is typed on a line, results are separated by dashed rules, and the only boxes left are controls: outlined buttons, dashed chips, and badges outlined in their network's hue. Wherever something is selected, it becomes a solid ink block. Space Mono sets everything that labels, counts, addresses or heads, and the platform sans is kept for paragraphs. There are no corners, no shadows and no raised surfaces.

The layout is phone first and moderately dense: one column, 48px rows for anything you touch, and capitals only for state and controls. The search page (crates/omnid/src/ui) and the Android chrome (res/values*/colors.xml, MainActivity.kt, BrowserActivity.kt) share one token set, one typeface and one set of rules, so the browser's toolbar and tab list read as more pages of the same zine.
keyCharacteristics: The icon's navy palette, with one value per token in each scheme, shared by app.css and colors.xml.
Space Mono Bold for the wordmark, heads, titles, chips and buttons. Space Mono Regular for addresses, labels and meta. The platform sans for paragraphs.
Five text sizes: 11, 12.5, 15, 18 and 21.6px (the same in sp natively).
No corners anywhere: border-radius 0 on every field, control, block and dot.
Rules instead of boxes: a solid rule opens a section, dashed rules separate items, and a 2px ink line runs under every text field.
Selection is a solid ink block with ground-coloured text.
A periwinkle highlighter behind unread titles. Network hues are kept to squares and outlined badges.
Flat: no shadows and no tonal cards. Motion is short and decelerating, and results update in place.
Every touch target is at least 48px (48dp).

rules.name: The Ink Block Rule
rules.body: Selection and "on" look the same everywhere: a solid block of ink with ground text. This covers a selected chip, the shown tab in the tab list, selected text, and a hovered button. Anything inside the block, network badges included, turns to the ground colour. No hue, tint or accent fill marks selection.

rules.name: The Squares-and-Outlines Rule
rules.body: A network's hue appears only as an 8px square, as a 1px outline around its badge (with the badge's label in the same hue), and in the browser's kind badge. It is never a fill, a row tint or a rule.

rules.name: The Shared Ground Rule
rules.body: The window, status bar, navigation bar, action bar, browser toolbar and page all paint ground, so the app reads as one sheet. app.css and colors.xml carry the same value for the same name in each scheme. A token added on one side takes the other side's value.

rules.name: The Name Rule
rules.body: The product is written OMNId wherever people read it, OMN in capitals and the d lower case: in the wordmark, the launcher label, notifications and running copy ("OMNId crawls it next"). omnid in lower case is only the command, the package and code.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Space Mono sets everything that heads, labels, counts or addresses, including one-line status such as the summary and submit results. The platform sans sets paragraphs and nothing else.

rules.name: The Capitals Rule
rules.body: Capitals are for state and controls only: router names and states, the crawler's word, badges, chips, buttons, NOT ENCRYPTED, and the tab list's count. Titles, heads, addresses and paragraphs keep their own case. Capitals are tracked 0.04em at 12.5px and 0.06em at 11px.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Every piece of text uses one of five sizes: 11, 12.5, 15, 18 and 21.6px (sp natively). The upper four are 1.2 apart, and 11 exists for capitals. A sixth size is a bug.

rules.name: The 48 Floor Rule
rules.body: Every touch target is at least 48px (48dp). When the visual is smaller, the hit area grows and the shape does not. A 40px chip's input reaches 4px above and below it. 48px icon buttons sit 12px into the margin so their glyphs align with the text edge. Text buttons are 48px tall and pulled 0.75rem into the right margin so the word ends on the column edge.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are paper and nothing floats. Shadows exist only to draw lines and hollow squares, status squares carry no halo, and no element glows.

rules.name: The No Corners Rule
rules.body: border-radius is 0 everywhere. A rounded field, pill, circle dot or rounded button is a bug. The platform's dialogs, menus, borderless ripples and the launcher-mask icon on the start screen are known exceptions that have not been restyled yet; they are not a licence.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Groups are separated by lines, not enclosed. If something needs a border, it is a control. If it is content, it gets a rule above or below it.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: An unread title carries the highlighter: a hi underline 0.5em thick, offset -0.35em so it sits behind the lower half of the letters, with skip-ink off. On hover the stroke turns solid accent. Once the link is visited the stroke is gone and the title drops to ink-2. Explore site names carry the same stroke.

rules.name: The In-Place Rule
rules.body: Results replace each other where they stand. Rows already showing stay still, only new rows fade in (from 0.4 opacity, 4px lower, over 220ms), there is no spinner, and skeleton rows appear only when the index takes more than 150ms.

dos: Do mark selection and "on" with the ink block: ink fill and ground text, for chips, the shown tab, selected text and hovered buttons.
Do keep a network's hue to its 8px square, its outlined badge (a 1px hue outline and 11px bold capitals in the hue) and the browser's kind badge.
Do separate content with rules: solid 1px ink-2 to open a section, dashed 1px ink-2 between results, dashed 1px muted between Explore sites and router rows, and a 2px ink line under every text field.
Do keep every corner square (border-radius 0) on fields, buttons, chips, badges, blocks, frames and dots.
Do set heads, labels, counts, addresses and status lines in Space Mono, and paragraphs in the platform sans.
Do keep text on the five sizes (11, 12.5, 15, 18, 21.6), with capitals tracked 0.04em at 12.5px and 0.06em at 11px.
Do make every touch target at least 48px (48dp). When the visual is smaller, extend the hit area, not the shape.
Do paint the window, system bars, action bar, browser toolbar and page with the same ground, and give a new colour the same value in app.css and colors.xml for each scheme.
Do draw icons on a 24-unit grid with a 1.75 stroke, square caps, miter joins and no fill, stepping up to 2.25 only for 16px icons in buttons and chips and 12px badge icons.
Do shorten onion and .b32.i2p hosts to their first eight and last five characters, and Hyphanet keys to the type, the key's first eight characters and the site's name and path.
Do keep motion short and decelerating (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 160 to 240ms), update results in place, and turn all motion off under reduced motion.
Do serve any font from the daemon's own origin, as Space Mono is (font-src 'self').
donts: Don't round a corner, draw a pill or a circle dot, or put content in a card or a tonal box.
Don't fill a chip, tint a row or colour a rule with a network hue.
Don't add a shadow, glow or halo to anything. Box-shadow only draws lines and hollow squares.
Don't load a font, script or image from another origin.
Don't use glow as a fill. It marks focus, the caret and load progress only.
Don't set a paragraph in Space Mono, or a head, label, address or status line in the sans.
Don't set titles, heads, addresses or paragraphs in capitals.
Don't add a text size off the five-step ramp.
Don't show a spinner while searching.
Don't give the action bar or browser toolbar a colour band or elevation of its own.
